about: Anchor nodes of the library's graph: events, organisations, places and days that items connect to. Ids match the ids the main site already uses where one exists (event:web-summit-lisbon-2026, organisation:web-summit), so the two graphs meet at the same anchors. Topic, place and agent nodes made from items' tags and makers are matched to the main site's ids in catalogue/ontology-map.json. Wikidata ids are proposed by ontologist@ and not yet checked by the library; www.wikidata.org is linked, never read by machine.

nodes.label: Web Summit Lisbon 2026
nodes.note: 9 to 12 November 2026, Lisbon. Day Two (Wednesday 11 November) did not take place: Storm Charles, on the Portuguese Government's formal advice. No Wikidata item of its own for the 2026 edition (ontologist@, 18 November).

nodes.label: Web Summit (the conference series)
nodes.note: The conference that comes back each year; its 2026 Lisbon edition is event:web-summit-lisbon-2026. Not the company that runs it (organisation:web-summit).

nodes.label: Day Two, Wednesday 11 November 2026 (cancelled)
nodes.note: Did not take place: Storm Charles. Many sessions moved to Thursday.

nodes.label: Day Three, Thursday 12 November 2026
nodes.note: The final day, with sessions rescheduled from Wednesday.

nodes.label: Storm Charles
nodes.note: The storm that closed Web Summit's Day Two, November 2026.
